subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Hi Daniel —

Great to get connected. We're excited to walk your team through a 30–45 minute demo of Redwood’s inference platform and discuss how we can help reduce inference costs and improve latency for your routing/optimization models.

Can you share availability for next week (Mon/Tue/Wed)? I'm proposing:
- Tue 3/2, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 3/3, 14:00–14:45 PT

I've cc'd Marissa (SE) who will run the technical portion and Stephanie (deal lead) who can cover procurement and contracting questions. If you prefer a different time, happy to accommodate.

Thanks,
Dev
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: demo-availability.png (stub)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-team@acme-logistics.com, procurement@acme-logistics.com, security@acme-logistics.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Hi Dev —

Thanks for the options. Unfortunately we're facing an internal outage this week that pulled our SREs onto incident response, and several folks are traveling for a site visit on Tue/Wed. Travel + incident means we can't commit to the proposed times.

Could we look at Thu 3/4 or Mon 3/8 instead? Ideally we'd have the following folks attend: myself (platform), two engineers from routing (eng-team), procurement for contracting questions, and security for the data flow discussion.

Appreciate your flexibility —
Daniel
Platform Lead, Acme Logistics

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Thanks for the update, Daniel — totally understand. Sorry to hear about the outage and the travel.

Marissa, Stephanie — looping you in to coordinate new options. We should make sure security and procurement topics are covered up front. Lauren, can your team join to answer procurement / licensing questions?

Daniel — we can do Thu 3/4 at 10:00–10:45 PT or Mon 3/8 at 11:00–11:45 PT. If those don’t work, share a couple of preferred windows and we’ll adjust.

I’ll prepare a short agenda: 10 min intro & use case, 20 min live demo (model serving + observability), 10–15 min Q&A (incl. procurement/security).

Would you prefer an invite with a separate security deep-dive follow-up, or include a quick data flow Q&A in this session?

Thanks,
Dev
Attachment: proposed-agenda.txt (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Hi all —

I can run Thu 3/4 at 10:00 PT. For the session I’ll include:
- Short architecture diagram of inference flow
- Live demo of a 2-model routing example (latency / cost comparison)
- Quick look at our security controls (VPC/private deployment options, KMS integration)

If security needs a deeper conversation, we can follow up with a dedicated 30-min call next week.

Daniel — can you confirm who from security/procurement will join so we can tailor the materials? Also, if there are any network constraints (e.g., whitelisted IPs) please let us know — I’ll attach a simple network diagram.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: network-diagram.png (see attachments)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Hi Daniel —

I can join Thu 3/4 at 10:00 PT and will be prepared to walk procurement through our licensing model and typical timelines for Dedicated/Private deployments. If you have any preferred contractual terms or NDA requirements, please share them ahead of the meeting so I can bring the right docs.

Also copying a short checklist:
- Expected participants (names & emails)
- Any compliance docs to review (SOC 2, ISO)
- Primary procurement contact for follow-up

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Lauren
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-logistics.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-team@acme-logistics.com, procurement@acme-logistics.com, security@acme-logistics.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood product demo — scheduling with Acme Logistics

Thanks, everyone — Thu 3/4 at 10:00 PT works for our side. Attendees: Daniel Park (platform), Priya N. (routing lead, priya.n@acme-logistics.com), Sanjay M. (SRE), Procurement (procurement@acme-logistics.com), Security (security@acme-logistics.com).

We’ll send a calendar invite; please share the demo slides and the network diagram in advance. Looking forward to the session.

Daniel
